ops.title: prune: resolve CLOSED queue landings deeper than the squash window
ops.description: PR #426 bounded prSquashesOnBase to the newest 200*len(numbers) commits of origin/<base>. pruneLanded (internal/cli/prune.go) treats Graphite state CLOSED as landed only when prSquashOnBase finds the (#N) squash, with no queue-comment fallback, so a branch the Graphite queue landed more than 200 commits ago is no longer pruned (safe direction: left alone). Options: batch prune's CLOSED PRs through resolveQueueLandings (one GH comments request per miss), or check Graphite's PullRequestInfo.MergeCommitSha with git merge-base --is-ancestor if Graphite fills it for queue landings. Never reintroduce an unbounded --grep walk.

ops.text: ccx vcs prune deletes a branch whose PR Graphite reports CLOSED after a queue landing older than prSquashCandidates commits, with no unbounded history walk
